title: Design: deleting a category from its page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Open the page's three-dot menu.
  4. Click Delete.
  5. Click Delete in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • A small menu opens below the button with Audit Log, then Delete in red, as in picture 8.10.

Step 4:

  • A dialog titled "Delete", category A's name and "?" opens over a dimmed page, with an X at the top right.
  • Cancel and a red Delete sit at the bottom right.
  • The dialog's size and position match picture 8.11.

Step 5:

  • The Categories list shows one category fewer, and a white message at the bottom right reads category A's name with "deleted", as in picture 8.12.
